name: create-boba-app

scripts.lint: oxlint bin test site && prettier --check bin test site ".github/**/*.yml" socket.yml && npm --prefix template run lint
scripts.format: prettier --write bin test site ".github/**/*.yml" socket.yml && npm --prefix template run format
scripts.site:dev: npm run site && npm --prefix .site run dev
scripts.site:build: npm run site && npm --prefix .site run build
scripts.site:check: npm run site && npm --prefix .site run typecheck && playwright test -c .site

description: Scaffold a Boba app: native Web Components and TypeScript with no framework runtime
